DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 引っ越しに関する書類をお持ちですね。今日はどなたの分をご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have documents concerning your move. Whose paperwork would you like to discuss today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 自分の転入について来ましたが、家族の書類も同じ袋に入っています。先に私の分を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 自分の転入相談で家族書類も袋にあるため先に分けたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I came about registering my own move here, but my family's documents are in the same bag. I would like to separate mine first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you came about your own move registration, but your family's documents are in the bag too, so you want to separate them first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お名前を確かめて、書類を分けましょう。家族の方も一緒に引っ越されたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the names and separate the documents. Did your family move with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ日に引っ越しました。ただ、今日は私一人で来ていて、家族は仕事に出ています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族は同日転居したが仕事で本人は来ていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: We moved on the same day. However, I came alone today, and my family members are at work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that your family moved on the same day but are at work and have not come in person. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人以外の分を扱う条件は担当へ確認しましょう。ご自身の新しい住所が分かるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's ask the responsible staff about the conditions for handling someone else's paperwork. Do you have anything showing your own new address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 新住所のメモがあります。書類の中には旧住所のものもあるので、どれを使うか教えてほしいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 新住所メモと旧住所書類があり使うものを教えてほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have a note of the new address. Some documents still show the old address, so I would like you to tell me which ones to use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a new-address note and old-address documents, and ask which to use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当窓口で書類を確認します。ここでは新旧の住所と、ご本人の書類を見分けておきましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The responsible counter will check the documents. Here, let's distinguish the old and new addresses and identify your own documents.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族の分が今日できなくても、自分の相談だけ進めたいです。不足するものを家族に伝えるためメモできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族分ができなくても自分は進め不足を記録して伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even if my family's paperwork cannot be done today, I would like to proceed with my own consultation. May I take notes to tell them what is missing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to proceed with your own consultation even if your family's paperwork cannot be done, and record what is missing to tell them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認した不足と、本人以外の相談の条件を記録できます。判断できない点は担当から案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can record the missing items we confirm and the conditions for consulting on someone else's behalf. The responsible staff will explain anything we cannot determine.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 自分の書類と住所メモを先に出します。家族の分の条件は別に聞き、帰って本人へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の書類を先に出し家族の条件は別に聞いて本人に伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll present my own documents and address note first. I'll ask separately about the conditions for my family's paperwork and tell them when I get home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will present your own documents first, ask separately about your family's conditions, and tell the people concerned. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ではご本人の書類から窓口へご案内します。家族のものを混ぜずにお持ちください。ご相談が済みましたら、書類を忘れずにお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll direct you to the counter, starting with your own documents. Please keep your family's documents separate. When your consultation is over, remember to take your documents home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約についてのご相談ですね。現在の日時が分かるものを拝見できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss your appointment. May I see something showing the current date and time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この予約票です。付き添う家族の勤務が変わり、予定の朝には一緒に来られなくなりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約票を示し家族の勤務で朝に同行できなくなったと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Here is the appointment slip. The work schedule of the family member accompanying me changed, so they can no longer come with me that morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the appointment slip and explain that your family member can no longer accompany you in the morning because of work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 予約内容を確認して担当へ相談します。変更をご希望なのは日付ですか、時刻ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll check the appointment details and consult the responsible staff. Do you want to change the date or the time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: できれば同じ日の午後ですが、家族の勤務が終わる時刻もまだ確かめていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同日午後を希望するが家族の退勤時刻は未確認だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Preferably to the afternoon of the same day, but I haven't yet checked what time my family member finishes work.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you prefer the same afternoon but have not confirmed when your family member finishes work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 候補を決める前に予定を整理しましょう。受診日時について、担当者から説明されたことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's organize the schedule before choosing an alternative. Has the responsible staff explained anything about when you should be seen?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 次に来る日として、この日を案内されました。自分だけで別の日に延ばしてよいのかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 案内された日を自己判断で延期してよいか分からないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was told to return on this date. I don't know whether I can decide on my own to postpone it to another day.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether you may independently postpone the date you were given. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 受診の時期については診療担当に確認します。家族が来られる候補も、確認してから相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check with the clinical staff about the timing of your visit. After you confirm when your family member can come, we can discuss those alternatives too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: いま家族に勤務の時刻を聞きます。変更できると決まるまでは、元の予約を取り消さないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に予定を聞き変更確定前に元の予約を取り消さないでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll ask my family member about their work hours now. Please don't cancel the original appointment until a change is confirmed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your family member about their schedule, and request that the original appointment not be canceled before a change is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の予約の扱いも確認して進めます。担当からの案内とご家族の返事を合わせて、次の予定を決めましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll also confirm how to handle the original appointment before proceeding. Let's decide the next arrangement based on both the staff's guidance and your family member's reply.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族の返事を伝え、担当に受診の時期を確認します。新しい予定が決まったら予約票も見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の返事と担当の受診時期を確認し予約票を見直すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll pass on my family member's reply and check with the staff when I should be seen. Once the new arrangement is decided, I'll check the appointment slip again too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will relay your family member's reply, confirm the timing of the visit with staff, and recheck the appointment slip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では担当へ状況を伝えます。日時が確定しましたら、また内容をご確認ください。ご家族への確認の間は、こちらでお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I'll explain the situation to the responsible staff. Please check the details again once the date and time are confirmed. Wait here while checking with your family member.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 自転車が見当たらないのですね。最後にご自身で見たのはいつでしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your bicycle is missing. When did you last see it yourself?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の夕方、家の駐輪場所に置きました。今朝見たらありませんが、家族も使うので、何が起きたか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日夕方置き今朝なく家族も使うため経緯不明だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left it in the bicycle parking area at home yesterday evening. It was gone when I looked this morning, but my family uses it too, so I don't know what happened.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you parked it yesterday evening and found it missing this morning, but do not know what happened because your family also uses it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 共用の状況も伺います。家族の方には、使ったかどうか尋ねましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: I'll ask about the shared use too. Have you asked your family members whether they used it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一人には聞いて使っていないと分かりました。もう一人は仕事中で、まだ返事がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一人は未使用と確認できもう一人の返事は未着だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I asked one person and confirmed they hadn't used it. The other is at work and hasn't replied yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that one person has confirmed not using it, while you are still waiting for the other's reply. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できたことと未確認のことを分けましょう。自転車の特徴を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's separate what has been confirmed from what hasn't. Please describe the bicycle.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 黒い車体で、後ろの荷台に黄色い箱を付けています。最近の写真も携帯にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 黒い車体と黄色い箱を説明し写真を持っていると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: It has a black frame and a yellow box attached to the rear rack. I also have a recent photo on my phone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the black frame and yellow box and say that you have a photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 写真を見ながら特徴を残せます。登録番号などの書類は持ってきていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We can record its features while looking at the photo. Have you brought any documents showing its registration number or similar information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 書類は家です。今は番号を覚えていないので、帰って探してから伝えたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 書類は家で番号を覚えておらず探して伝えたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The documents are at home. I don't remember the number now, so I would like to look for them when I get home and then tell you.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that the documents are at home, that you do not remember the number, and that you will look for it and report it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 番号は推測せず確認してください。家族から返事が来た場合も、状況を知らせていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm the number rather than guessing it. If your family member replies, could you also let us know the situation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族の返事を待ち、書類で番号も調べます。共用していることと、今朝から見当たらないことを分けてお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 家族の返事と書類を調べ共用と紛失の事実を分けて伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll wait for my family member's reply and check the number in the documents. I'll explain separately that we share the bicycle and that it has been missing since this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check your family's reply and the documents, and report shared use separately from the fact that it is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では今分かる情報を伺います。写真と経緯を確認しましょう。追加の情報が分かったら、またご相談ください。お帰りの際もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's hear what you know now. We'll check the photo and what happened. Please contact us again if you learn anything further. Take care on your way home too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類の発送ですね。提出先から送り方の指定はありましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are sending documents. Did the recipient specify a mailing method?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内には記録を残して送るとありますが、送った証拠なのか、届いた確認なのか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発送の証拠か配達の確認かが分からないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: The instructions say to send them with a record, but I don't know whether that means proof of sending or confirmation that they arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether it means proof of sending or delivery confirmation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な記録を確かめてから選びましょう。提出先の案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's establish what record is needed before choosing. Do you have the recipient's instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙です。追跡できる方法とも書いてありますが、記録という言葉と同じ意味か迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 案内の追跡と記録が同じ意味か迷うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here is the paper. It also says to use a trackable method, but I'm unsure whether that means the same thing as a record.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you are unsure whether tracking and a record mean the same thing in the instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 商品の案内で確認できる記録の種類を比べましょう。案内だけで指定が分からなければ、提出先にも尋ねられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's compare the types of records described in the service information. If the instructions do not make the requirement clear, you can ask the recipient too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 提出先には、何を保存する必要があるか聞きたいです。書類は原本なので、発送を決める前に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本なので必要な保存記録を提出先へ聞いてから発送したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to ask the recipient what I need to keep as a record. These are original documents, so I'll check before deciding to send them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that these are originals and that you want to ask the recipient what records to retain before mailing them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 保存する記録と必要な扱いが分かると、方法を相談しやすくなります。宛先と期限も確認済みですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Knowing the record to keep and the handling required makes it easier to discuss a method. Have you also confirmed the address and deadline?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宛先は写しましたが、期限の意味はまだです。届く日なのか出す日なのかも、同じ電話で聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宛先は用意し期限が到着か発送かも電話で聞くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I copied the address, but haven't confirmed what the deadline means. I'll ask in the same call whether it's the arrival date or the sending date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you have the address ready and will also ask by phone whether the deadline concerns arrival or dispatch. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認がそろったら、使える方法と条件や料金を見ましょう。今の封筒はまだ閉じていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you have all the information, let's look at the available methods, conditions and prices. Have you left the envelope unsealed for now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まだ閉じていません。原本と宛先を見直し、保存する記録と期限を提出先に聞いてから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未封の原本と宛先を見直し記録と期限を確かめて再持参すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I haven't sealed it yet. I'll recheck the originals and address, ask the recipient about the records to keep and the deadline, and then bring them back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will recheck the unsealed originals and address, confirm the records and deadline, and bring them back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では確認してから発送方法を選びましょう。案内の紙もお持ち帰りください。準備が整いましたら、またお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's choose a mailing method after you check. Please take the instruction sheet home too. We look forward to seeing you again when you're ready.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 新しい口座についてですね。利用する目的と、ご用意したものを教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a new account. Please tell me what you will use it for and what you have prepared.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 給料を受け取るためです。勤務先の案内と持ってきた書類で、名前の表記が少し違うので相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与受取りが目的で勤務先の案内と持参書類の名前が違うと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: It's to receive my salary. I would like to ask about a slight difference in how my name appears in my employer's instructions and the documents I brought.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the account is for receiving salary and that your name differs between your employer's instructions and the documents you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表記の違いを確認してから、必要な書類をご案内します。どのように違っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check the difference in the name before explaining the necessary documents. How do they differ?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 勤務先の紙では名前の一部が省略されています。自分の書類は省略していないので、同じにしてよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先では名前の一部が省略され同じ表記にしてよいか不明だと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Part of my name is abbreviated on my employer's paper. It isn't abbreviated on my own documents, so I don't know whether I should make them match.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your employer has abbreviated part of your name and that you do not know whether to use that same form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の正確な情報と勤務先への確認を分けましょう。住所については現在のものが分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's distinguish your accurate personal information from what needs to be checked with your employer. Do you have something showing your current address?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 引っ越したばかりです。書類に古い住所が残っているので、今の住所を確認するため何が必要か聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 転居直後で旧住所の書類から新住所確認に必要なものを聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I've just moved. My documents still show the old address, so I want to ask what is needed to confirm my current one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you have just moved and ask what is needed to verify the new address when your documents show the old one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 状況に合う必要書類を、現在の案内で確認します。今日は開設をすぐ終える予定でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll check the current guidance for the documents needed in your situation. Were you planning to finish opening the account immediately today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今日は相談だけでもかまいません。名前と住所で足りないものを持ち帰り、そろえてから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 今日は相談でもよく不足を持ち帰り準備後に申し込みたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's fine just to consult today. I'd like to take home a list of what is missing for my name and address, prepare it, and then apply.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that a consultation is enough today, and that you want to take note of missing items and apply once prepared. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認できた項目をメモにしましょう。勤務先の担当者にも、名前の表記について尋ねられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's make a note of the items we confirm. Can you also ask the responsible person at work about how your name is written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 勤務先には省略の理由を聞きます。銀行の案内で必要な書類を確認し、正確な名前と新住所が分かるものを用意します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 省略理由は勤務先に尋ね必要書類は銀行案内で確認し用意すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask my employer why it was abbreviated. I'll check the bank's guidance on the required documents and prepare proof of my full accurate name and new address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will ask your employer about the abbreviation and check the bank's guidance to prepare the necessary documents. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では表記と住所を順に見ましょう。必要事項の案内を持って、準備ができたらまたご相談ください。お仕事の新しい生活が順調に進みますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's look at the name and address in order. Take the guidance on the requirements, and consult us again when you're ready. I hope your new working life goes smoothly.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 棚の値札が見づらかったですか。手に取った商品のどれと比べたいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Was the shelf price label hard to understand? Which of the products you picked up would you like to compare it with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 同じ名前の大小二つの袋です。小さい袋の下に大きい袋の値札があるようで、価格を取り違えそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同名の大小袋で小袋下に大袋札があり価格を取り違えそうだと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: These two bags, large and small, have the same name. The large bag's label seems to be below the small bag, so I might mix up the prices.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the large and small bags have the same name and that the large bag's label appears below the small bag, which could cause a price mix-up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋の容量と値札の記載を照合しましょう。小さいほうには何と書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's match the quantities on the bags with the price labels. What does the smaller one say?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 二百グラムです。大きいほうは五百グラムですが、値札の数字を量だと思って読んでいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二百と五百グラムを読み値札の数字を量と思っていたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two hundred grams. The large one is five hundred grams, but I was reading the number on the price label as the quantity.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the two hundred and five hundred grams and explain that you had mistaken the price-label number for the quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 量と価格を分けて見ていきましょう。同じ名前でも、種類の表示も確かめる必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's look at quantity and price separately. Even with the same name, we also need to check the type indicated.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 片方には細切りと書いてありました。量だけでなく形も違うので、自分が使うものか確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 片方が細切りなので量以外に用途へ合うか確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: One says finely shredded. The shape differs as well as the quantity, so I want to check whether it's suitable for what I'll make.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that one is finely shredded, so you want to check its suitability for your use as well as the quantity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 使いたい形と容量を決めてから、対応する価格を確かめましょう。今日はどれくらい必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's decide the shape and quantity you want, then confirm the corresponding price. How much do you need today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一回の料理に少しだけ使います。大袋が割安でも、残りを使う予定がないので小袋を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 一回分で残りの予定がなく割安さだけで大袋を選ばないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll use just a little for one meal. Even if the large bag is better value, I have no plans for the rest, so I'm considering the small one.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you only need enough for one meal and have no plans for leftovers, so you will not choose the large bag solely for its value. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 小袋の種類と値札を一緒に確認できます。表示が対応しない場合は、会計前に売場で確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: We can check the small bag's type and price label together. If the label doesn't match, let's check in the aisle before checkout.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二百グラムの袋で、形が料理に合うかを見ます。その商品の価格を確認してからかごに入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 二百グラムの形を見てその商品の価格確認後にかごへ入れると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look at the two-hundred-gram bag to see whether its shape suits my cooking. I'll confirm that product's price before putting it in my basket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the shape of the two-hundred-gram product and put it in your basket after confirming its price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では小袋の記載から確かめますね。価格が分かったら、納得して選んでください。お料理に合うお買い物になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then let's start by checking the small bag's label. Once you know the price, choose whichever you are happy with. I hope you find something that suits your cooking.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 公園の道を選んでいるところですね。今日はどんな場所を歩きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You're choosing a path through the park. What sort of place would you like to walk in today?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日差しを避けて少し歩きたいです。地図に木の印がありますが、その道が今も日陰か分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 日差しを避けたいが木の印だけでは現在の日陰が不明だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a short walk out of the sun. There are tree symbols on the map, but I don't know whether that path is shaded now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to avoid the sun but cannot tell from the tree symbols whether there is shade now. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 木の印だけでは、現在の日陰は分かりませんね。現地の様子を確認しながら短く歩く案はいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The tree symbols alone don't tell us where the shade is now. How about a short walk while checking the actual conditions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い道から始めたいです。日なたが続くなら、途中で戻れる道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短く始め日なたが続けば戻る道を知りたいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like to start with a short path. Please show me a route back in case the sunny stretches continue.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you want to start with a short route and know how to return if there is prolonged sun. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 戻る出口を先に確かめましょう。こちらの入口から入られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's first identify the exit to return to. Did you come through this entrance?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 入口は反対側でした。案内所へ来るまで少し歩いたので、戻るときに別の出口へ出ないか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 反対入口から案内所まで歩き帰りに違う出口へ出ないか心配だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I entered on the opposite side. I've already walked a little to get to the information center, so I'm worried about coming out through a different exit on the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you walked from the opposite entrance to the information center and are worried about using a different exit on the way back. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 入った入口を案内図で一緒に探しましょう。近くに覚えている目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let's find the entrance you used on the map together. Do you remember any nearby landmark?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 花の形の案内板がありました。その入口の近くに座れる場所があるなら、歩かずに休む案も考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 花形案内板を示し入口近くで歩かず休む案も検討すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: There was a flower-shaped information board. If there is somewhere to sit near that entrance, I might rest instead of walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mention the flower-shaped board and say that you are also considering resting near the entrance without walking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入口と休む場所を、図と現地の案内で確認しましょう。歩くかどうかは様子を見て決められます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let's check the entrance and resting places using both the map and the signs there. You can decide whether to walk after seeing the conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 入った入口と休む場所を確かめます。日陰が少なければ無理に歩かず、休んで同じ入口から帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入口と休む場所を確認し日陰が少なければ休んで同じ入口から帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll check the entrance I used and a place to rest. If there isn't much shade, I won't force myself to walk; I'll rest and leave through the same entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the entrance and resting place, and if shade is scarce, rest and leave through the same entrance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: まず入口の目印を整理しましょう。地図をお持ちになり、今日の様子に合わせてお過ごしください。どうぞのんびりした時間になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40212-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Let's first establish the entrance's landmark. Take the map and adjust your visit to today's conditions. I hope you have a relaxing time.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗換案内をお持ちですね。どの部分で迷っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have transfer directions. Which part is confusing?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: このメモでは途中で乗り換えます。同じホームに列車が二つ来るようですが、どちらでもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗換メモの列車をどちらにするか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: This note says to change trains along the way. Two trains seem to use the same platform; can I take either one?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask which train to take according to your transfer note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ホームだけで決めず、列車の行き先も照らしましょう。メモの乗り換える駅を見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's compare the train's destination too, rather than deciding by platform alone. Show me the transfer station in your note.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらの駅です。最終目的地の名前だけ見ていたので、途中の駅を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 最終目的地と乗換駅を見分けて示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's this station. I was only looking at the final destination and overlooked the intermediate station.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the final destination from the transfer station and point them out. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 途中で降りる駅と、その後の行き先を分けて確認しましょう。今来ている列車の表示は読めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's check the station where you get off en route separately from where you go after that. Can you read the display on the train arriving now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表示は読めますが、メモの途中駅に停まるかはわかりません。発車しそうでも、確認前には乗らないでおきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発車を急がず途中駅に停まるか確認を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can read it, but I don't know whether it stops at the intermediate station in my note. Even if it looks ready to depart, I won't board until I've checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Do not rush to depart; wait to confirm whether the train stops at the intermediate station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 停車駅を確認してご案内します。乗り換え後のホームは、乗換駅の表示も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I'll check its stops and advise you. Please also check the signs at the transfer station for the platform after changing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乗換先のホーム番号が変わることもあるのですね。メモだけに頼らず、そこで表示を見直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現地の表示でホームを再確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the platform number for the connecting train can change too. I'll check the signs again there instead of relying only on my note.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will confirm the platform again using the signs at the station. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: メモを持って、降りる駅と次の列車の行き先を照らしてください。わからなければ現地の係員にも聞けます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Keep your note and compare the station where you get off with the next train's destination. If you're unsure, you can also ask the staff there.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 最初の列車の停車駅を確認し、途中駅で降ります。次のホームと行き先は現地で確かめ、同じホームだからと乗りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 停車駅と降車駅と乗換後の行き先を順に確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll confirm the first train's stops and get off at the intermediate station. I'll check the next platform and destination there and won't board just because it's the same platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the stops, the station where you get off, and the destination after transferring in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認する点がわかりましたね。こちらでは最初の列車をご案内します。メモをお忘れなく。それでは、道中お気を付けて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Now you know what to check. Here, I'll guide you to the first train. Don't forget your note. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書についてですね。提出先からの案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about a certificate. Do you have the instructions from the organization receiving it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 住まいの契約で、住所がわかる証明を求められました。家族の情報も載ったものを頼めばよいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 住所証明に家族の情報も必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: For my housing contract, I was asked for proof of my address. Should I request a document that also includes my family's details?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether proof of address also needs your family's information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 必要な記載内容を確かめて選びましょう。提出先から、ご本人だけか家族も必要か指定されていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's check the required information before choosing. Did the recipient specify whether it should cover only you or your family too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこまでは聞いていません。「住所がわかるもの」とだけ言われたので、勝手に多くの情報を載せないほうがよさそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 住所がわかるという指示だけで記載を増やさない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I haven't asked that much. They only said something showing my address, so it seems better not to add extra information on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Do not add information when the only instruction is to show your address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 指定がわかれば担当へ相談しやすくなります。証明書の名前や発行時期の条件も案内にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Knowing the requirements makes it easier to consult the responsible staff. Do the instructions also specify the certificate's name or how recently it must be issued?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 書類名も時期も書かれていません。提出先に、本人だけの情報でよいかと、必要な書類名を聞き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 本人情報でよいかと正式な書類名を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: Neither the document name nor timing is written. I'll ask the recipient again whether my information alone is enough and which document they need.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether your own information is enough and what the document's official name is. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その確認後に担当窓口でご相談ください。申請する人や持ち物についても、状況に合わせて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: After checking that, consult the responsible counter. We'll also confirm who will apply and what to bring for your situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分で申請する予定です。提出先に聞く項目と、こちらで確認する持ち物を別々にメモしてもいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人申請の持ち物を提出先への質問と分けて残す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I plan to apply myself. May I separately note the questions for the recipient and the items to bring that I should check here?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Record what to bring for your own application separately from the questions for the recipient. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、分けて記録してください。料金や受取方法も、選ぶ証明書が決まってからご案内を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, record them separately. Once the certificate is chosen, let's check the guidance on the fee and collection method too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 提出先へ書類名と記載範囲と時期の条件を聞きます。その後、自分で申請するための持ち物と料金を窓口で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 提出条件を聞いてから窓口で持ち物と料金を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll ask the recipient about the document's name, the information to include, and issue-date requirements. Then I'll confirm at the counter what to bring and the fee for applying myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the submission requirements first, then check what to bring and the fee at the counter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請前に用途を整理できました。確認した案内を持って担当へご相談ください。本日はありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: You've clarified the purpose before applying. Bring the instructions you've confirmed and consult the responsible staff. Thank you for coming today.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で手が止まっていましたね。読みにくい所やわからない言葉はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: You paused while filling in the medical questionnaire. Is there anything hard to read or any word you don't understand?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: せきの「頻度」とありますが、長さを書くのですか。それとも、何回出るかを書くのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 頻度が長さか回数かを確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: It asks about the frequency of my cough. Should I write how long it lasts, or how many times I cough?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Check whether frequency means duration or number of occurrences. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでは、どのくらいの回数や間隔で出るかを伺います。覚えている範囲でお話しいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, we ask how often it happens or the intervals between episodes. Could you tell me what you remember?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 昨日の夜、何度か出ました。昼には気になりませんでしたが、正確な回数は数えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夜に何度か出たが正確には数えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I coughed several times last night. It didn't bother me during the day, but I haven't counted the exact number.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you coughed several times at night but did not count the exact number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 数えていないことも伝えてください。いつから気になっているかは覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also mention that you didn't count. Do you remember when it started bothering you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 気になり始めたのは一昨日です。「毎日」と選ぶ欄がありますが、二晩だけでもそう書いてよいかわかりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二晩の症状を毎日という欄で選べるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I started noticing it the day before yesterday. There is an every-day option, but I don't know whether I can select it when it's only been two nights.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can choose every day for symptoms occurring over two nights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 欄を無理に選ばず、その二晩の様子を言葉で伝えましょう。私が記入の相談を担当へつなぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Don't force yourself to choose an option; describe those two nights in words. I'll refer your question about filling it in to the responsible staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一昨日と昨日の夜に何度か出た、と書きたいです。回数を想像して数字にしなくてもよいのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二晩の様子を言葉にし回数を推測しない。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'd like to write that I coughed several times the night before last and last night. So I don't have to guess a number of times, do I?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the two nights in words without guessing the number of times. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確かに覚えていることと、数えていないことを分けて確認します。今の状態についても担当へ伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll distinguish what you remember clearly from what you didn't count. Is there anything about your current condition you also want to tell the staff?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今はせきが出ていません。二晩のことと今のことを分けて伝え、わからない欄は担当に相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 現在せきがないことと二晩のことを担当へ伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'm not coughing now. I'd like to explain the two nights separately from how I am now and ask the responsible staff about the fields I don't understand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Tell the staff that you are not coughing now and describe those two nights. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容を引き継ぎます。記入を確認する担当へご案内しますので、問診票をお持ちください。お話しいただき、ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-40213-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll pass that information on. Please bring your questionnaire as I direct you to the staff who check it. Thank you for telling me.
